rssMB.meaning: process RSS after 200 ticks must sit at or under this many MB

checkpointMB.meaning: the snapshot.json checkpoint must sit at or under this many MB

ticksPerSec.meaning: ticks per second over the measured run must sit at or above this rate

arms.flat512: BRAIN_HV_HEAP_MB=512, the flat size core/simd.mjs chose on its own before the plan hook
arms.planned: the default, the size SIMD.plan() chooses for this organism
arms.heapOff: BRAIN_HV_HEAP_MB=0, how much of what is left the hypervector heap holds

sites.note: BRAIN_HV_HEAP_SITES=1, one run, not comparable on time
